content:
elaine: quick sync — we need to reconcile customer asks for long audit retention with product constraints. proposal: define an "MVP retention profile" + an "enterprise extended" path. thoughts? :thinking:

sanjay: +1 on two-track. customers asking for 7y retention is the outlier. most want 90/365/3y buckets. we should model costs first.

maria: can we support per-tenant override in Private/Dedicated only? non-starter for hosted unless we do billed storage tiers.

kevin: per-tenant overrides in dedicated yes. hosted would need either >cold-archive export or metered storage. storage infra + egress will be non-trivial.

elaine: noted. product constraints: 1) hosted must be safe for multi-tenant; 2) dedicated can do custom retention + BYOK; 3) private is full control. checklist for MVP retention profile:
- default 90 days incr + 1y cold archive
- retention toggle (tenant-level) only in Dedicated/Private
- exportable evidence package (downloadable) for >1y

sanjay: add acceptance criteria: ability to query audit events by tenant id and time range within SLA (95% < 2s for 30d queries)

maria: legal asks: SOC2 evidence collection must be complete for the audited window — if we offer export, it needs integrity proof (hash + manifest). Ariane, fyi @ariane-legal

ariane-legal: confirm — export + manifest ok. we also need documented chain-of-custody for >1y retention claims. recommend signed manifest with key rotation notes.

kevin: implementation note: we'll use per-tenant object prefixes + lifecycle policies. sample retention config (conceptual):
```
retention_profile: "90-day-default"
hot_ttl_days: 90
cold_transition_days: 30
cold_ttl_days: 365
exportable: true
```

ops-oncall: potential oncall impact: longer retention increases disk usage on Dedicated clusters; recommend a quota+alerting plan before GA.

elaine: good catch. action items:
- sanjay: run cost model for 90d/1y/3y and per-tenant overrides by 3/31
- kevin: tech spike for export manifest + signed hashes + rotation doc by 4/7
- infra: quota + alerts design, include capacity soft-limits by 4/7
- ariane-legal: sign-off criteria for chain-of-custody and manifest format by 4/3

maria: also need clear UX in Console: retention toggle state, active archival jobs, and estimated cost per tenant. UX spike by 4/10?

elaine: yep. target: ship MVP retention profile + exportables in Q2 beta for Dedicated/Private. hosted extended retention to be a Q3 pilot with metered storage. callout: BYOK/KMS ties into export integrity — tie keystore story to export manifest flow.

sanjay: for BYOK, customers will want the manifest signed by their key. implement path: customer-provided public key -> we sign manifest then encrypt with their KMS? needs design.

kevin: tech caveat: BYOK in Hosted has regulatory concerns (we don't hold keys but we still need to produce signed manifest). design doc will layout options: customer-sign vs platform-sign-with-customer-key-wrapping.

elaine: if we agree to this plan, I'll include as the roadmap proposal for PM review and schedule a 30-min decision sync next week. thumbs? :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

sanjay: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

ariane-legal: :thumbsup:

elaine: awesome — filing this as the retention + BYOK scoping proposal. I'll post the doc link once I draft it. thanks everyone.
